description: Source code for BN_CTX management in OpenSSL, implementing functions for context creation, initialization, cleanup, and management of BIGNUM objects.

methods.name: BN_CTX_new
methods.description: Creates and allocates a new BN_CTX structure.

methods.name: BN_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees a BN_CTX structure and its associated resources.

methods.name: BN_CTX_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a new temporary BIGNUM context.

methods.name: BN_CTX_get
methods.description: Retrieves a BIGNUM from the context, or NULL if none available.

methods.name: BN_CTX_end
methods.description: Ends a temporary BIGNUM context, restoring previous state.
